t: This Sandtex 10Ltr Ultra Smooth Masonry Paint in Cornish Cream provides a durable and protective finish for exterior walls. Its advanced Microseal Technology ensures a hard-wearing, dirt-resistant, and waterproof barrier, suitable for concrete, pebble-dash, render, and stone. This high-quality, water-based masonry paint is formulated for straightforward application by brush, roller, or spray, offering excellent coverage of 12-16 m² per litre and allowing recoating in just 3-4 hours. It is an ideal choice for refreshing house exteriors or large commercial buildings, providing a long-lasting, ultra-smooth appearance even in challenging British weather conditions.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
